entities.name: NAFLD
observations: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease assessed by MRI/MRS, CT, or liver biopsy in the cited human studies.

entities.name: PAI-1
observations: In a Taiwanese MRI/MRS case-control study, PAI-1 remained independently associated with NAFLD after multivariable adjustment; OR 1.39, P=0.039.
In CARDIA, higher PAI-1 was prospectively associated with midlife CT-defined NAFLD: adjusted OR 2.16 and 2.71 per 1-SD higher log PAI-1 at two assessments.
In biopsy patients, steatosis independently predicted PAI-1 alongside fasting C-peptide and waist circumference.

entities.name: Leptin
observations: In the Taiwanese study, females had higher leptin than males overall; NAFLD-associated hyperleptinemia differed by sex and was age-dependent in females.
Leptin findings are context-dependent; pediatric evidence may show an opposite association with steatosis.

entities.name: Adiponectin
observations: In the Taiwanese study, females had higher adiponectin than males overall; lower adiponectin in NAFLD and its age pattern differed by sex.

entities.name: PAI-1 independent NAFLD
observations: Human observational evidence supports an adjusted association between PAI-1 and NAFLD beyond measured metabolic covariates, but does not establish causal independence.

entities.name: Sex adipokine variation
observations: Leptin and adiponectin concentrations and their NAFLD-associated patterns vary by sex and age, though the pattern is not universal across ages and phenotypes.
